claims.claim: Hayden Panettiere began appearing in commercials at 11 months old.
She worked in soap operas as a child, including One Life to Live and Guiding Light.
Her notable screen work included A Bug's Life, Remember the Titans, Heroes, Nashville, Scream 4 and Scream VI.
She received two Golden Globe nominations for her performance as Juliette Barnes in Nashville.
She publicly discussed addiction, depression and postpartum depression.
Her younger brother Jansen died in 2023.
She returned to the Scream franchise as Kirby Reed in Scream VI in 2023.
Her memoir This Is Me: A Reckoning was published in May 2026.
In May 2026, Panettiere publicly said she was bisexual and described fear of public opinion and concern about what her team would think.
Panettiere said she had very little privacy and described paparazzi following her.
Hayden Panettiere died on August 16, 2026, at age 36 in Greenville, South Carolina.
As of August 22, 2026, her official cause of death remained undetermined and under investigation.
Authorities reported no signs of trauma and no suspected foul play.
Panettiere's public life began before she could form memories and continued across childhood and adulthood.
A defensible editorial interpretation is that much of her adult public narrative involved trying to define herself beyond roles and expectations formed around her from childhood.
